tax.profile.dependents.children.desc: Children fiscally at your charge increase the tax-free allowance. 2025 example scale shown in help text.
tax.profile.dependents.others.desc: Other persons at your charge (e.g. dependent parents). Each adds to your tax-free allowance.
tax.profile.description: Configure your tax situation for accurate Belgian PIT calculations.
tax.profile.employment.civil_servant.des: Government employee; special social security rules may apply.
tax.profile.employment.director.desc: Remunerated company director or executive; 3% lump-sum professional expense forfait applies.
tax.profile.employment.director.label: Company director
tax.profile.employment.employee.desc: Work under employment contract; social security withheld at source.
tax.profile.employment.employee.label: Employee
tax.profile.employment.other.desc: Student, unemployed, or mixed income situation.
tax.profile.employment.other.label: Other
tax.profile.employment.retired.desc: Pension income; may follow different withholding/tax profiles.
tax.profile.employment.retired.label: Retired
tax.profile.employment.self_employed.des: Freelancer or sole-proprietor; only actual professional expenses are deductible (no statutory forfait).
tax.profile.field.cadastralIncome.desc: Used for regional property tax reference. Enter the annual cadastral income value found on property documents.
tax.profile.field.childrenDisabled.desc: Children with a recognised disability count as TWO on the dependent-children scale (CIR-92 art. 132 4°). Bumps the supplement to the next tier.
tax.profile.field.communalSurcharge.desc: Percentage added to federal PIT by your municipality (0%-9%). Check your aanslagbiljet or SPF Finance for the precise rate.
tax.profile.field.disabilityExemption.de: Captured in your profile but not broken out into a separate quantified deduction in this estimator.
tax.profile.field.domesticHelpCosts: Domestic help / household staff costs (annual EUR)
tax.profile.field.grossAnnualIncome.desc: Your total annual salary, pension or freelance revenue before any deductions. Enter amounts in EUR.
tax.profile.field.isolatedParent.desc: Single parent with at least one dependent child; adds €1,980 (IY 2025) to the personal exemption.
tax.profile.field.isolatedParent.label: Single parent (isolated)
tax.profile.field.mortgageInterestPaid: Mortgage interest paid (main residence, annual EUR)
tax.profile.field.mortgageIsPrimaryResid: Required for regional own-home tax credit (Flemish woonbonus, Walloon chèque habitat).
tax.profile.field.otherTaxableIncome.des: Rental income, foreign income, freelance work on top of salary, etc. Enter annual amounts in EUR.
tax.profile.field.othersDisabled.desc: Other dependents with a recognised disability count as TWO on the scale (CIR-92 art. 136).
tax.profile.field.unionDues.desc: Counts as actual professional expenses (CIR-92 art. 49) -- only applied when you itemize actual expenses instead of the lump-sum forfait. Leave at 0 if already included in your actual expenses.
tax.profile.profExp.actual.desc: Track real work-related costs that can be documented for deduction.
tax.profile.profExp.actual.label: Actual expenses
tax.profile.profExp.lump.desc: 30% of gross professional income, capped at EUR 5,930 (informational).
tax.profile.profExp.lump.label: Lump-sum (Forfait)
tax.profile.region.brussels.label: Brussels-Capital Region
tax.profile.region.flanders.desc: Flemish Region -- property taxes and some surcharges differ.
tax.profile.region.flanders.label: Flanders (Vlaanderen)
tax.profile.region.wallonia.desc: Walloon Region -- slightly higher average communal surcharges.
tax.profile.region.wallonia.label: Wallonia (Wallonie)
tax.profile.section.employment.desc: Select the employment category that best matches your main income source.

tax.profile.section.incomeSources.desc: Pick the categories that count as taxable income for the Tax Overview graphs.
tax.profile.section.incomeSources.note: Without this, every positive-amount transaction (refunds, transfers, gifts) would be treated as salary subject to PIT. Pick only categories that represent genuinely taxable income.
tax.profile.section.incomeSources.title: Taxable income sources
tax.profile.section.otherDeductions.desc: Enter annual amounts for other deductible items. These are applied with pragmatic caps for estimation.
tax.profile.section.ownHome.desc: Regional credit on your primary-residence mortgage. Implemented for Flemish woonbonus (mortgages signed before 2020) and Walloon chèque habitat (mortgages signed 2016+). Brussels and post-2020 Flemish mortgages have no annual credit modeled.
tax.profile.section.ownHome.note: Simplified estimate. Walloon chèque habitat has an income-based phaseout and decreasing tail (years 11-20) that are not modeled here. Verify with your tax advisor for filing.
tax.profile.section.ownHome.title: Own-home credit
tax.profile.section.professionalExpenses: Choose whether to use the standard lump-sum deduction or report actual work-related expenses.
tax.profile.section.region.desc: Pick your administrative region and set the municipal surcharge (opcentiemen) applied to federal PIT.
tax.profile.section.region.title: Region & communal surcharge
tax.profile.section.residences.desc: Add properties you own to estimate regional property taxes and cadastral income.

tax.propertyTaxDesc: Annual tax on real estate ownership (cadastral income based).
tax.recordedVsManualDesc: Compare totals from transactions with your manual yearly adjustments.
tax.reyndersEstimateDesc: 30% on realized gains from investments classified as `bond`. Mixed ETFs / funds need manual entry -- fund composition is not tracked.
tax.reyndersInterestPortion.desc: Share of the realised gain taxed at 30% under Reynders. Pure accumulating bond funds: 100%. Mixed funds: lower. The remainder is taxed at 10% CGT from IY 2026.
tax.rules.description: Quick explanation of rules behind the calculator.
tax.rules.investment.dividends: Belgian dividends: first EUR 859 exempt, then 30% WHT
tax.rules.investment.foreign: Foreign dividends/interest: declare yearly, treaty credit may apply
tax.rules.investment.savings: Belgian savings interest: first EUR 1,050 exempt, then 15% WHT
tax.rules.other.tob: Stock exchange transactions (TOB/Beurstaks) may apply to buys/sells
tax.rules.other.vat: VAT rates: 21% standard, 12% reduced, 6% reduced, 0% for specific supplies
tax.rules.ss.selfEmployed: Self-employed contributions follow different legal bases
tax.rules.ss.special: Special social security contribution: approx. EUR 9.30 to EUR 60.94/month (not deductible)
tax.rules.title: Belgian tax rules used
tax.subjectToReynders.desc: Direct bond gains are exempt pre-2026; from IY 2026 they fall under the 10% CGT. Bond / mixed-bond funds pay 30% on the interest portion (remainder routed to CGT in 2026).
tax.suggestions.alimony.applied: Alimony is treated as an 80% deductible item from taxable base; estimated tax saving shown using your marginal rate (illustrative).
tax.suggestions.childcare.noAmount: You marked childcare eligible but did not enter costs. The credit is 45% up to €16.90/day (2025) per eligible child -- provide eligible days for a tighter cap.
tax.suggestions.childcare.notMarked: You entered childcare costs but did not mark them eligible. Mark to apply the 45% federal credit up to the daily cap.
tax.suggestions.childcare.suggest: You have dependents; childcare costs may qualify for a 45% credit. Example used: {days} eligible days.
tax.suggestions.domestic.noAmount: You marked domestic help eligible but did not enter costs. PwC: 30% credit when eligible (caps and conditions vary).
tax.suggestions.domestic.notMarked: You entered domestic help costs but did not mark them eligible. Mark to apply the 30% credit.
tax.suggestions.donations.noAmount: You marked charitable donations eligible but did not enter an amount. PwC: 45% reduction for qualifying donations (minimum €40 to recognised EEA institutions).
tax.suggestions.donations.notMarked: You entered donations but did not mark them eligible. Mark as qualifying donations to apply the 45% reduction.
tax.suggestions.donations.note: 45% credit for qualifying donations ≥ €40 to recognised EEA institutions (PwC).
tax.suggestions.group.noAmount: You marked group insurance eligible but did not enter a contribution amount. Employee group insurance often qualifies for a federal credit.
tax.suggestions.group.notMarked: You entered group insurance contributions but did not mark them eligible. Mark to apply the federal credit (~30%).
tax.suggestions.group.suggest: If you are an employee, employee group insurance contributions may entitle you to a federal credit (30%).
tax.suggestions.life.noAmount: You marked life insurance as eligible but did not enter a premium amount. PwC cap: €2,530 @30%.
tax.suggestions.life.notMarked: You entered life insurance premiums but did not mark them eligible. Mark to apply the 30% federal credit (up to cap).
tax.suggestions.multipleResidencesNote: If you own multiple properties, the portfolio tax page shows estimated regional property taxes per residence; an aggregated estimate is included in the general tax totals as informational only.
tax.suggestions.none: No obvious missing deductions detected. Review regional items below or open your tax profile to confirm inputs.
tax.suggestions.pension.noAmount: You marked pension contributions as eligible but did not enter an amount. PwC: up to €1,050 @30% (standard) or €1,350 @25% (alternative).
tax.suggestions.pension.notMarked: You entered pension contributions but did not mark them eligible. Mark as eligible to apply the federal tax credit.
tax.suggestions.pension.suggest: Pension savings may provide a federal tax credit. Consider contributing (PwC ceilings apply).
tax.suggestions.regionalDesc: Examples: mortgage capital repayment relief, service-checks, security investments, renovation/maintenance incentives. These are region-specific and not auto-applied to federal PIT.
tax.suggestions.regionalNote: Regional deductions are listed for your reference and are not automatically applied to federal PIT.
tax.suggestions.regionalTitle: Regional items you may qualify for
tax.suggestions.title: Possible deductions / credits you may qualify for
tax.tacrEstimateDesc: Approximated as 0.15% of aggregate portfolio value once it exceeds €1M. Actual liability is per account.
tax.taxByAssetClassDesc: Taxes and fees broken down by asset class.
tax.taxCategoriesDesc: Common tax types relevant to personal finance.
tax.taxTypesDesc: Breakdown by tax and fee type.
tax.tobAutoEstimateDesc: Estimated from buy amounts × asset-class rate (bond 0.12%, stock 0.35%, ETF distributing 0.12%, capped per leg).
tax.tobTrackedFromBuyTaxes: Summed from taxes attached to buy transactions
